Subject: ACE registration + strategic coverage plan / PDM & PSM intros — NovaGrid opportunity

Hi team,

Quick context: NovaGrid (SaaS, energy analytics) surfaced a pilot that could scale across multiple accounts — estimated initial ARR ~$350k and strong upsell potential. They told us they want to be listed in the AWS Marketplace and pursue the ACE co-sell motion. Samantha and Tom are the primary contacts.

Immediate asks:
- Laura / Hiro: can you lead PDM/PSM coverage for this deal? We need PDM pairing for the AWS intake and a PSM to be introduced to the customer in the handshake call.
- Marcus: can you pull the Marketplace listing checklist (pricing SKU, entitlements, listing owner) and confirm any gaps vs NovaGrid's current packaging?
- Samantha / Tom: please attach the MAP (if available) and confirm ideal week/time for an intro with AWS ACE.

Attachments: NovaGrid-MAP-v1.pdf (customer-provided), ace-registration-screenshot.png (they started the ACE form but hit an error at submission).

Proposed timeline: ACE registration + PDM intro this week, PSM intro in follow-up next week, intake map filled and HubSpot updated by end of week.

Next steps I will take: open the HubSpot deal (RDW-2027-NOVA-03) and add intake notes; cc-ing ace-ops for visibility.

Thanks,
Priyom
Senior Account Executive
Redwood Inference
Phone: +1 415-555-0182

Internal checklist attached: RDW-internal-ace-checklist.xlsx (PDM intake items, required artifacts, pre-call demo notes).
